title: Nugyman.jar
description: Purple men will attack you. Forge 1.20.1
body:
# Purple men that hunt you down in packs!
![Two of the entity.nugyman.nugy entities](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6cb997509ae881c72d5216fab89f1eac0ddd5956.png)
Coordinated predators capable of wiping out villages in seconds, the only way to stop them is to destroy (prevent mob spawning in) their pyramids that have defiled your world.
